A caller must build MeshOptions (frame, height_at_dir, quads, lattice at :49-56); no binary code calls it (git grep finds no use outside the file). The type is not Send: it holds Rc<Quad> (:537) and Box<dyn MeshLattice> (:53), so it can only be a NonSend resource or must be reworked before it can sit in a bevy system. MeshLattice is implemented only by a test MockLattice (:709), so wiring needs an impl for LatticeSurface (methods exist at src/lattice_surface.rs:183-200) and so un-gates lattice_surface too. A renderer consumer for the DrawnQuads output (:42-47) does not exist.
ungate_chain: None for its own imports: height::anchor (src/height/mod.rs:8) and js_math are compiled in. Optional chain lattice_surface (src/main.rs:34) only if the MeshLattice impl is added.
conflicts: planet_lod already tiles and plans the near ground: NearField::plan at src/planet_lod/near_field.rs:132, with quadtree.rs and patch.rs; two strategies would cover the same ground. gap-131 is the documented GroundNodeGrid; this module gives only the no-ground sentinel, not a grid.
dead_code_risk: Warnings only: Cargo.toml has no [lints] table, src/main.rs has no #![deny] attribute, and a search of scripts, .cargo and .github found no -D warnings, so un-gating cannot fail the build; until a caller exists every pub item in the module warns as dead code.
size_reason: The module is a whole second near-ground renderer with a non-Send design and no consumer; it overlaps planet_lod, so wiring it means choosing one near-field path. Un-gating alone is S.
